method.performance: Measured pass/pass pairs with identical tag, case and repeat. Median of paired relative reductions, not ratio of separate medians. Positive reduction means less time or memory. Warmups and failed runs excluded.
method.memory: Windows peak process commit (PeakPagefileUsage) and peak working set, in MiB. Whole-process metrics, not dictionary allocation alone.
method.occupancy: Fraction of nonzero saved concentration values, not a direct count of dictionary keys; tiny accumulated doubles may round to zero in float output.
method.fidelity: Paired comparisons include failed outputs to expose regressions. Relative L1 is sum absolute differences divided by reference sum.
